notes.title: Patch 1.60
notes.notes:
To celebrate the announcement of Poly Bridge 3, we are releasing a major update with two new bonus worlds (32 levels!) and plenty of fixes and improvements!

New Worlds

 Challenge yourself with 32 new levels in Glittering Gorge and GleamTown!

Improvements

Added "Collides With Vehicles" option to custom shapes.
Added Sandbox option to not allow spring adjustments.
Hover over custom shapes for collision info.
Don't show static pins on custom shapes in Build Mode.
Optimizations: Enabled support for Graphics Jobs and Incremental Garbage Collection.
Added fallback font for missing characters in foreign languages.
Updated Main Menu banner.

Fixes

Don't play water ambient audio on levels with no water.
Fixed issue with platforms and ramps disappearing on transition from Simulation to Sandbox.

notes.title: Patch 1.36 and our new game announced!
notes.notes:
Our new game!
After 5 years of work, we're happy to finally reveal the new game we've been working on, Plasma.
Plasma is an engineering sandbox. Unleash your creativity with fun and intuitive robotics, physics, and visual programming tools.

Wishlist Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1409160

v1.36 Patch Notes

This update brings several new features and improvements! Please check out the notes below for the details.

New Features:
* Erase Mode: Easily erase parts of a bridge using the mouse pointer
* Edge Bisect: Allows you to draw onto the middle of a truss
* Selection Set Nudge: Move a selection set by increments in Sandbox Mode
* Steam Rich Presence
* Added "No Water" option in Sandbox Mode
* Added "Mute In Background" to Audio Options
* Added "Mute" to Audio Options

UI Improvements:
* Added icon for Move Mode to make it easier for beginners to understand nodes can be moved
* Persist piston and spring sliders for a short time when pointer leaves the slider hitbox
* Added option for turning off tooltips (Settings > Other > Disable Tooltips)
* Allow custom shape verts to be much closer together
* Allow ramp spline nodes to overlap

Community Translators

The Community Localization google spreadsheet has been updated with new keys added for the update.  These will default to English translation until they get added to your language pack mod.

notes.title: Patch 1.25
notes.notes:
We have added six new levels to World 6, bringing the total number of levels to 96 across 6 different worlds!  This update has many improvements and bug fixes, which are detailed below.  Thank you for playing Poly Bridge 2!

New Content

 Six new levels added to World 6.
 Added Sailboat.


Twitch Integration

Added a button to remove all suggestions and a button to unmute all players.  A special thanks to aliensrock for his creative use of the Twitch Integration for a "Battle Royale" contest that led to the need for these new buttons.


Improvements

 Improved Stuck Falling Road Detection (should no longer be a viable technique).
 Disable Stuck Falling Road Detection in Unbreakable Mode.
 Added “Has Breaks” icon to Gallery Items with breaks.
 Added “Challenge Levels” toggle to the Worlds UI
 Show a green checkmark on Workshop levels that have been completed.
 Added "Autoplay Only" and "Exclude Autoplay" to Workshop Search filters.
 Auto-Triangulate now works with the Spring material.
 Auto-Triangulate is no longer blocked by rope and cable.
 Improved Event Flow readability when there are multiple timelines.
 Improved anti Z-fighting technique for custom shapes and terrain.
 Up/Down arrow keys now navigate levels in the Workshop Campaign panel (hold Shift + Up/Down arrow to navigate campaigns).
 Warn about losing Sandbox changes if leaving Sandbox with bridge changes that are not saved.
 Added cheat check for having split nodes in a level without any hydraulic phases.
 Platform surface now stays fixed when adjusting leg height in Sandbox Mode.
 Show terrain mesh when hovering over the “Cycle Variant” button in Sandbox Mode.
 Make Platforms and Ramps slightly wider so they draw in front of Custom Shapes.
 Hide pins on custom shapes during simulation when shape is static (2 pins).
 Custom Shapes: Disable “Collides With Split Nodes and Roads Connecting To Split Nodes” checkbox if both “Collide with Road” and “Collide with Nodes” 
 Don't show vehicle tooltips or do vehicle highlighting when drawing.
 Clear First Break indicator when edge changes by undo/redo.
 Ensure the First Break indicator is always drawn on top of all objects.
 Increased number of checkpoint pickup sounds that can play at once.
 Disable Replays by default if system RAM less than 4GB (can be re-enabled in Settings > Other).
 Use AppData/LocalLow location for saves on new installs on Windows (less likely to cause issues with anti-virus/defender software compared to Documents location).


Fixes

 Fixed issue with bridges not loading for Autoplay Workshop levels.
 Fixed issue with other player solutions not showing for Weekly Challenge levels.
 Fixed issue with Weekly Challenge scores sometimes not submitting to the back end.
 Fixed issue with Rotation not updating in Sandbox Mode when degrees symbol present.
 Fixed issue where extra entries could be added to Classic Campaigns UI.
 Fixed issue where trace fill plays audio for currently selected material instead of material being placed.
 Fixed issue with hydraulics slider arrow sometimes not showing up after undo.
 Fixed issue with hydraulics sleeve disappearing in simulation if starting simulation while adjusting slider arrow.
 Fixed issue with dynamic anchors on custom shapes being affected by custom shape scale.
 Fixed issue with split joint numbers sometimes being rotated.
 Fixed issue with split joint numbers showing 1 instead of lock icon when anchor replaces a split node.
 Fixed issue with being able to control level under Gallery when Gallery is started from a loaded Workshop level.
 Fixed bug that prevented editing a Workshop title/description when viewed from the Workshop Campaign UI.
 Fixed issue with Workshop Campaign info being hidden after going to Gallery from within Workshop.
 Fixed text on Twitch Settings UI when Russian Language enabled.
 Fixed untranslated “Unbreaking” in My Rankings UI.
 Fixed save directory on Macs if not valid (sometimes Unity will try to use com.Company.ProductName instead of Dry Cactus/Poly Bridge 2.

notes.title: Patch 1.21
notes.notes:
Weekly Challenges
We are pleased to announce Weekly Challenges for Poly Bridge 2!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37217019/c6e7ecc98a9df8443669cc0b5fc7006a6edc0bae.png

Every week starting Monday at midnight UTC we will release a new Weekly Challenge level that you will see on the Main Menu.

Each weekly challenge has a leaderboard, but scores can only be submitted during the week it is active! You will still be able to play past challenges.

Falling Roads
Falling roads are a much less useful technique for solving levels, although there is still some further tweaking to be done. We did not intend for falling roads to be a common way to beat levels, so old leaderboard scores that use falling road solutions will be removed.

Auto Triangulate
Players now have the option of enabling Auto Triangulate. When enabled, drawing wood or steel will automatically connect to nearby nodes. It can be a neat way to quickly draw bridges, try it out!  This setting is not saved to your profile, so it is not persistent across game sessions.

Improvements

 Reordered levels in World 5 (Serenity Valley) for a smoother difficulty curve.
 Renamed Featured Tab to Popular in Workshop. Tab now shows the most Popular levels for the past week and the levels you have most recently played.
 Change icon order in top bar to Undo/Redo/Trash instead of Trash/Redo/Undo.
 Added check for illegal node locations in cheat detection.
 Highlight vehicles in Build Mode when hovering over vehicle icon in the Hydraulic Controller.
 Allow budget save slots to be deleted.
 Added rename/delete icons for slots on Sandbox Load panel.
 Don't allow anchors to stack on top of each other when creating multiple anchors in Sandbox Mode.
 Allow anchors to be moved off grid with the mouse in Sandbox Mode.
 Reset scrollbar for Workshop Description when viewing a Workshop Item.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue with node movement sometimes causing unexpected snapping to draw boundary.
 Fixed issue with Workshop replays not showing up as other player solutions on the Level Complete screen.
 Fixed issue with partial pages of Workshop items in the Gallery.
 Fixed rare crash when starting a parallel hydraulics phase that had been early merged and is connected to springs.
 Fixed issue with simulation speed not updating if previously quit with simulation paused.
 Fixed issue with extra boat/plane being added to stage if duplicated from multiple selection in Sandbox.
 Fixed issue with gallery item caching that could cause visual glitch when changing pages.
 Fixed issue with duplicated boats/planes not being assigned to an Event Stage.
 Fixed issue with duplicated custom shapes not preserving flipped flag.
 Fixed issue with multiply selected custom shapes separating when zooming while moving the mouse.
 Fixed issue where trace line tooltip could draw on top the Level Info and other UI panels.
 Fixed issue with arrow keys paging through Workshop when Update Workshop panel is active.
 Fixed issue with off-center disabled phase icon in Hydraulics Controller when phase itself was not centered.
 Fixed incorrect red color used on 3-way split joints on custom shapes.


Silent Update Sept 1

 Fixed overdraw exploit possible with Auto Triangulate.
 Added Clear Trace hotkey (default: backquote).

notes.title: The fab physics bridge-builder Poly Bridge 2 gets a huge free content update
notes.notes: Already finished Poly Bridge 2? Looks like it's time to jump back in as Dry Cactus have just released a huge free content upgrade with lots of new goodies to play with.

notes.title: Patch 1.20
notes.notes:
World 5

Welcome to Serenity Valley, a shiny new world with 16 levels and challenges!
New achievements added.


Sandbox Mode

New theme and new vehicle type.
Added support for duplicating multiple selected items.
Accurate selection for boats and planes.
Added custom shape option: collide with split joints.
Undo multiple changes (from holding down a button or key) in one undo step.


Hydraulics Controller Improvements

Panel is now semi-transparent, and you can click through it to add/remove split joints and hydraulics.
When using "Remove All" on a phase, any new split nodes or hydraulics will not automatically be added to phase.  This is indicated by a red slash through the hydraulics phase.  "Add All" will reverse that and return to default behavior for the phase.
Vertical scrollbar added when there are too many phases to fit on the panel.
Fixed issues with undo and 3-way split joint state.
Fixed issue with "3-way Split Joints" toggle resetting after simulation.


Level Updates and Balance Changes

Swap Levels 'Compression' (3-2) and 'String Theory' (2-13).
Increase Limo Horsepower on 'Low Rider' (2-3).
Added Cable to challenge level 'Lean on Me ' (4-11) and increased budget to 86k.
Update 'Buggy Bouncer' (2-4) to lower rocks and reduce speed of Dune Buggy.   Cleared leaderboard scores for this level.
Added static anchor to 'Cross Jump' (3-11).


Twitch Integration

Support added for optional Subscribers Only mode.
Allow auto-saves when using Twitch integration if suggested bridge has been changed.


Usability Improvements

Don't show re-center button when there is something to paste.
Improved system to highlight vehicles/flags/checkpoints in Build Mode.
Allow updating existing Workshop levels (you now have choice to overwrite or create new).
Improved collision accuracy for Hydrofoil and Sea Plane.
Optimized parsing of ranks info at startup to remove stall on Main Menu.
Left/Right arrow keys on Leaderboards screen to cycle to previous/next board.
Highlight items on hover in all drop-down menus.
Disable search options in Workshop when viewing recently played items.
Show "Solution Has Breaks" on Gallery Video panel if replay had breaks.
Show red cancel button on warning popup related to a workshop level failing to download (rather than green check).
Hide the Workshop Campaign panel when loading or showing "no items found" message.


Bug Fixes

Fixed Sandbox Mode undo issues with custom shapes.
Fixed issue where overlapping nodes could occur if traceline draws over itself.
Fixed issue with showing stress when boats/planes hit a platform or ramp.
Fixed issue where you could access a locked challenge world using up/down keys.
Fixed issue in My Rankings that could cause a rank to be shown as very large number.
Fixed issue where Twitch auto-save could carry over to next level.
Fixed issue with sometimes not seeing the replay that is double clicked on the level complete UI.
Fixed issue with ramp in Edit Mode drawing behind bridge pieces.
Fixed issue with zooming in Sandbox Mode when using mouse wheel on vehicle drop-down menus.
Fixed issue with level lights affecting the bridge in Build Mode.
Fixed issue with grid intersecting very wide objects.
Fixed issue with Undo not working for disabling a split node.
Fixed issue with leaving Sandbox Mode while dragging an item for placement with the mouse.
Fixed issue with loading popular workshop items twice on Featured Page if leaving page during initial load.


Further Updates (since v1.20)

Fixed issue with Gallery not filtering properly by level name.
Fixed issue with sharing to Gallery failing (server issue).
Fixed issue with Gallery not returning items when both World and Level selected.

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.notes:
Leaderboard Improvements
We have finished reworking the Leaderboards to make them more accurate and much faster to load and made a few changes:

The Competitive range is now the Top 1000, if your score falls within that range your are shown the exact rank plus the ranks and scores of people immediately above you and at the top
Outside of the Competitive range, effectively if your rank is not in the Top 1000, you are shown your rank and the percentile you fall in, while also being shown who is in the top places and what score you need to break into the Top 1000.

We will be adding more improvements to the Leaderboards as we go along, please let us know what you think and if you find any issues.

Patch Notes

Added hotkey to cycle between different points of view (default binding is V)
Fixed crash when doing a trace fill and starting simulation on the same frame
Fixed rare crash when navigating gallery videos
Fixed non-determinism issue that could occur with boats/planes

'My Ranks' screen still inaccurate - we aim to have this done by next week also

notes.title: Patch 1.11
notes.notes:
Some more improvements and fixes in today's patch, 1.11.

Patch Notes

Gallery loading and navigation improvements
Workshop loading and navigation improvements
Added Like button on Level Complete Screen for Workshop Levels
Added Vsync option to Graphics Settings (enabled by default)

Upcoming Leaderboard Changes
We've been hard at work behind the scenes to bring major improvements to the Leaderboards, both in terms of speed and reliability.
This will address the 'Unbreaking' leaderboards sorting incorrectly as well as provide a better experience across the board.
We hope to roll out these changes next week, in the meantime we thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: Patch 1.09 and Linux support
notes.notes:
Today we have a number of fixes going in with version 1.09 and we are happy to include Linux support!

Patch 1.09

Fixed missing text issue (affected some Mac setups)
Featured Tab and Featured Workshop Items have returned
Fixed issue with conflicting Workshop item IDs
Fixed issue with incorrect collision from the Yellow Sub
Tuned UI size on Main Menu, Campaign, Workshop and Gallery


Linux Support
We were finally able to iron out the last issue with the Linux build, please note however that Replay Recording is currently disabled while we look into a solution to support that feature.

notes.title: Patch 1.08
notes.notes:
We have been busy at work fixing issues and improving server reliability, today we have lots of bugfixes going out and some ongoing online issues that we are addressing.

Patch Notes for 1.06, 1.07, and 1.08:

Improved network performance.
Fixed uploading to Workshop errors.
Fixed issue that could cause split joint numbers to overlap.
Fixed issue where roads couldn't overdraw when at material limit and highlighting node outside placement radius.
Fixed issue where roads couldn't overdraw a same-type road when at material limit.
Fixed clipped text in some input fields.
Smoothed out stress display.
Report max stress if bridge broken by boats/planes.
Use System Documents folder on Windows for save data
Clear cheat indicator if restoring a save that had cheats enabled previously but didn't actually cheat
Verify at least 1 anchor exists before uploading to Workshop
Fixed UI issues when running game across multiple montiors
Fixed issue with completion stats on workshop levels not updating after the initial victory
Fixed issue with not being able to upload to Workshop if solution bridge cost was same as budget
Fixed issue being able to Load Bridge in Simulation (pause same frame as starting simulation)
Warn about unsaved changes in Sandbox if quitting to main menu from Level Complete or Level Fail Screens
Fixed vehicle audio not starting with very low vehicle speeds
Fixed platform/road Z-fighting
Localized "First Break" text
Optimized performance


Upcoming Server Changes
To make our Leaderboards more responsive and reliable we are implementing a number of changes this week.
This shouldn't affect players much, although there might some occasional down-time.
Specifically, we aim to improve:

'My Ranks' Screen being more reliable and real-time
Steam Friends sync working as intended to see friend's leaderboards
Workshop navigation being faster and more user friendly
Gallery navigation improvements

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 and server issues
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.5

Better handling of server errors
Fix non-determinism with cars failing when touching water (was using interpolated visual meshes for testing)
Fix issues with tracing that could result in overlapping joints
Handle corrupted savefiles better
Updated "Missed Checkpoint" notification that had gone missing
Fixed incorrect theme for Wibbly Wobbly
Fixed graphical glitch in Build Mode when moving mouse quickly after dismissing Info panel
Fix for materials displays in various panels
Fix for positioning of 'copy link location' buttons relative to text in various panels
Fix for incorrect displayed bridge cost if trace auto-fill is active when switching to simulation
Fix for stress color display going beyond red if in 'unbreaking' mode in sandbox
Disabled discord/reddit buttons for a short while after you press them, to prevent multiple web pages opening
Fix issue where "Submitting to Workshop..." popup would remain up forever if error occurs when submitting
Hydraulic tutorial fixes
Twitch: Added budget to bridge preview
Twitch: Prevent tutorial from working with Twitch integration


Known Issues

Leaderboards might not always refresh correctly when improving score for the next 12-24 hours
Mac text rendering still having issues on some setups


Server Issues
We've been experiencing server issues for a few days now, initially we were targeted by a DDoS attack, then had some infrastructure problems because of that, finally we just found some issues with how we're attempting to handle real-time calculation of ranks which is causing our databases to fail intermittently.
We are working hard to resolve any online functionality issues, rest assured we will not rest until everything is working smoothly as it should be, however we do appreciate your patience while we do our best to resolve things as quickly as possible.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
A new day, a new patch!
Today's patch, 1.02, includes the following:

Correctly handle saving if system doesn't allow writing files to user's Documents folder
Added toggle to hide other player solutions on the Level Complete Screen
Fixed issue with not being able to load Workshop levels in Sandbox if not previously downloaded
Other minor fixes


As always, if you find any issues or have feedback please let us know on the Steam forums or by emailing us at support@drycactus.com

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37217019/4a1187b675abd3a52efeb150d4bf613a64d1b393.png

After a busy day for the development team following release we're happy to say that everything is going smoothly and lots of players are enjoying Poly Bridge 2!
Thanks for your support and we hope you keep building more bridges!

We have a few fixes that were pushed to a new build just now, which include:

Support for Ultra Wide aspect ratios
Fixed issue with Steam Cloud not syncing correctly
Fixed issue with some systems not allowing save files under the user directory
Fixed issue with gallery sometimes not loading
Fixed issue with friends leaderboards sometimes not appearing
Fixed Steam issue for 32-bit Windows binaries


If you find issues or have suggestions, please feel free to reach on the Steam forums or directly to us at support@drycactus.com
